codes.cause: a unit was taken out of service or not found, with the pool, the unit, its location code and serial number

recovery.action: The pool runs on the units left, with less protection or none. Replace the disk: the pool rebuilds onto the new one or a hot spare, and the problem is cleared when the rebuild ends.
recovery.description: Disk unit &1 of storage pool &2 failed or is missing.

codes.cause: a unit of a protected pool failed and no hot spare was there to take, with the pool: another failure may lose it
codes.meaning: Storage pool degraded with no hot spare

recovery.action: Another failure may lose the pool. Replace the failed disk, or add a hot spare, as soon as you can.
recovery.description: Storage pool &1 is degraded and has no hot spare to rebuild onto.

codes.cause: a rebuild or resynchronization stopped, with the pool and why

recovery.action: The pool is still without its full protection. Look at the disk named, and replace it if it is failing.
recovery.description: The rebuild of storage pool &1 did not finish: &2.

codes.cause: more units are lost than the pool's protection covers: the pool is Failed, nothing more is written to its units, and its partitions are in Error

recovery.action: More units are lost than its protection covers. Nothing more is written to it and its partitions are in Error. Bring its units back, or make the pool again and restore its virtual disks.
recovery.description: Storage pool &1 failed: &2.

codes.cause: a pool's allocated space passed 80% of its size, with the pool, what is allocated and what is provisioned

recovery.action: A warning ahead of A2007051, which opens the problem.

codes.cause: the same at 90%

recovery.action: A thin virtual disk that cannot grow holds its partition. Delete what the pool does not need, or move virtual disks to another pool. The problem is cleared when less than 80% is allocated.
recovery.description: Storage pool &1 is 90% allocated: &2.

codes.cause: an import of an optical image failed, with the name and why; nothing of it is left

recovery.action: An import that fails is answered to whoever asked for it, and nothing of it is left.

codes.cause: a switch of the state file could not be built at the service's start, with its name and why; its partitions' required adapters cannot be given ports

recovery.action: Its partitions' adapters cannot be given ports. Deal with the reason, then change the switch at Service Tools option 3 or from a console.
recovery.description: Virtual switch &1 was not built: &2.

codes.cause: every interface of a switch's uplink lost carrier, with the switch and the location codes: outside traffic stops, traffic between its partitions goes on

recovery.action: Traffic between its partitions goes on; traffic to and from outside the host has stopped. Check the cables and the physical switch. The problem is cleared when carrier is back.
recovery.description: Every interface of the uplink of virtual switch &1 lost carrier.

codes.cause: one interface of a bonded uplink lost carrier, with the switch and its location code; the others carry the traffic

recovery.action: The bond's other interfaces carry the traffic, without redundancy. Check the cable and the physical switch's port. The problem is cleared when carrier is back.
recovery.description: Interface &1 of the uplink of virtual switch &2 lost carrier.

codes.cause: an interface the state names as an uplink is not on the host, with the switch and the location code

recovery.action: A card may have been moved or removed. Put it back, or change the switch's uplink.
recovery.description: Interface &1, in the uplink of virtual switch &2, is not on the host.

codes.cause: by PID 1's panic handler, with the panic message, before it parks

recovery.action: The host stopped. Take the system log to the release's supplier.
recovery.description: The host's first process failed: &1.

codes.cause: the storage service of a mirrored load source failed five times in ten minutes; the host parks

recovery.action: The host stopped, its data file system without a server. Restart the host.
recovery.description: The storage service of the mirrored load source stopped: &1.

codes.cause: an orderly shutdown began, with what asked for it
every partition was ended, in the reverse of their start order; the services are stopped next
services are stopped and `/data` is unmounted; power off follows
services are stopped and `/data` is unmounted; a restart follows
